text: Coverage: for this question, successful uploads into frothlywebcode while it was publicly accessible are measured in aws:s3:accesslogs object-write records, with the public-access window bounded by the two CloudTrail PutBucketAcl events on the same bucket.

Selection: OPEN_BUCKET_PLEASE_FIX.txt is the file asked for because among successful REST.PUT.OBJECT uploads to frothlywebcode inside the public window, it is the only text file; the only other successful in-window upload was frothly_html_memcached.tar.gz, which is not a text file.
rival: frothly_html_memcached.tar.gz uploaded successfully at 13:04:17 within the same public window, but it is a .tar.gz archive rather than a text file.
